title: Alpha-gal Syndrome | Alpha-gal Syndrome | CDC
content: Alpha-gal Syndrome About Alpha-gal syndrome can occur after certain types of tick bites and mostly affects adults. Learn More June 26, 2025 Symptoms Alpha-gal syndrome can cause hives, nausea, stomach pain, breathing issues, and swelling. Managing Symptoms To manage AGS, avoid some foods, prevent more tick bites, and seek urgent care if needed. Fast Facts Red meat, like beef and pork, plus dairy, some medicines, and other products contain alpha-gal. For Professionals Clinical Testing and Diagnosis Diagnose AGS with a detailed patient history, physical exam, and alpha-gal IgE antibody test. June 26, 2025 Clinical Resources Enhance your practice by taking an AGS clinician training and by reading the latest research.
